evals.prompt: We changed this skill and want to know whether it improves results. Design a fair evaluation.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates matching, neighboring, and ambiguous cases with observable assertions and a no-skill or previous-version baseline.
assertions: The response includes a clean-context baseline comparison
The response includes objective assertions with evidence requirements
The response accounts for human review and context cost
The response identifies non-discriminating assertions or model variance as evaluation limits

evals.prompt: Create a new skill for our API client and write its instructions.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the request to skill-authoring and does not substitute an evaluation plan unless measurement is requested.
assertions: The response identifies skill authoring as the closer workflow
The response does not invent evaluation results

evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the skill, task examples, baseline, and definition of useful outcomes before designing the evaluation.
assertions: The response requests the missing evaluation inputs
The response does not claim quality from the question alone

evals.prompt: Compare a skill with its baseline. The shared temporary parent contains unrelated repositories, and after the first outputs I want to add an assertion because only the skill condition mentioned it.
evals.expected_output: The agent isolates the fixture, excludes contaminated runs, grounds assertions in an authoritative contract before comparison, and reruns every condition if a justified criterion changes.
assertions: The response requires a dedicated evaluation root without unrelated repositories
The response excludes or reruns contaminated conditions
The response rejects post-hoc assertions based only on a favorable output difference
The response reruns every condition if an authoritative contract justifies a revised assertion
